BiblicalUsage: Medes = "middle land"; n pr m; 1) an inhabitant of Media; n pr loc; 2) the territory inhabited by the Medes; 2a) located northwest of Persia proper, south and southwest of the Caspian Sea, east of Armenia and Assyria, and west and northwest of the great salt desert of Iram
